name: 29668-imagechat-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: vision-language decoder (Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, 8.29B params, ~16.6 GB bf16): 28 language layers, hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 key/value heads, head_dim 128 (56 KiB of KV per token); 32-layer native-resolution ViT, patch 14, spatial merge 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 4800 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 29668. 32 streams is a memory bound: 32 conversations of ~20000 tokens is ~35 GB of KV, which fits what one H100 leaves after weights at 0.90 utilization.
workload: Synthetic multi-turn vision chat: one 480p gradient PNG (seed 29668) attached to the first user turn only, then a 100-turn conversation about it. Each user turn is a fresh 192-token message and each reply is exactly 8 tokens (min=max, so max_tokens=8 with ignore_eos). Conversation history is replayed, so turn k re-sends everything said so far and the prompt grows from a few hundred tokens at turn 0 to roughly 20000 at turn 99. 4800 requests is 48 complete conversations.
purpose: A vision chat assistant discussing one uploaded image over 100 growing turns, 32 concurrent conversations, single GPU.
launch:
# Serving configuration for this item.
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
# Forced by the workload: 100 turns x (192 + 8) tokens, plus the image's own tokens and
# the chat template.
max-model-len: 32768
enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
